A row publishes to its entry only when status is APPROVED; then run python -m pipeline.apply_lab_numbers --run-date <date>. The applied number carries the pinned benchmark name and version; the benchmark_name_as_stated and quote fields are the evidence trail. unpinned_claims and not_found are records of the research, never applied.

context_notes: OpenAI publicly stopped reporting SWE-bench Verified on 2026-02-23 ('Why SWE-bench Verified no longer measures frontier coding capabilities': 'This is why we have stopped reporting SWE-bench Verified scores'), predating both releases. Both announcements report 'SWE-Bench Pro (Public)' instead (GPT-5.5: 58.6%, GPT-5.4: 57.7%), a different benchmark, not recorded as SWE-bench Verified. Third-party sites attribute an '88.7% SWE-Bench Verified, OpenAI-reported' figure to GPT-5.5 with no citation; no official OpenAI source exists, so it was excluded. System card PDFs mention GPQA and SWE-Bench Verified only as components of a safety suite, with no capability scores.
